title: 7 Best Adalo Alternatives in 2026: Honest Comparison
summary: Adalo alternatives ranked for builders who want push notifications, more than one published app, and a real AI assistant without stepping up plans. Blink, FlutterFlow, Thunkable, Rork, Draftbit, Glide, Replit.
body_markdown:
Blink, for a builder who wants push, a managed database, subscriptions, and an in-app AI gateway from one prompt. Adalo's own pricing page puts push on the $52/mo Professional plan.


Yes, with unlimited test apps and up to 500 records per app. Store publishing starts at $36/mo on Starter. Blink's free plan lets you build and preview a full-stack app with a database and sign-in.


No code export is listed on any Adalo plan. Blink creates a GitHub repo from day one, synced both ways, and FlutterFlow and Draftbit offer code export on their entry paid plans.


Yes, its assistant Ada builds and edits apps from prompts and is labeled beta. Blink puts 74 text models plus image, video, and voice models inside the apps you ship.
